steps.name: A New Encounter
steps.objective: A new encounter awaits you near the Arena in Elias.

lines.text: Hey, adventurer! Hello! Got a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A young girl's voice calls me to a stop.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A pretty face... but someone I don't know.)
I watched you fight in the arena! ♪ Eee! You're so strong. So. Cool. ♥
I've been waiting for a strong adventurer like you. Want to have a cup of tea with me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She seems strange. I'd better get away.)
Wait! Wait!! Don't ignore me! I'm not trying to pick you up! And I'm not selling anything!
Awen told me about you, so I came to meet you, %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The familiar name makes me stop.)
Our adventurer doesn't take the bait on the first try. Hehe. ♥
All right, all right. Enough joking. I'll explain properly.
My name is Parmila. I'm the leader of the Oscuras Mercenaries.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ah, that expression. I'm used to it. You're wondering how a girl who looks so young and weak could lead a mercenary company, right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Sorry to disappoint you, but it's true!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The truth is, I have a little problem, so I'm looking for a skilled adventurer.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'm such a busy person that I've neglected my social life... I hardly know anyone. Sniff.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I've heard your name quite often from Awen and Einst.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And from Ambrosia and Jade too.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, Lena talks about you as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...She seems to know quite a lot of people.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, from what I've heard, you seem trustworthy. And from what I saw earlier, your skills look good too...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So, do you take requests? If you're not busy, would you help me?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'd like to explain the details somewhere else...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If you accept, we'll go to the Mysterious Forest together, and I'll tell you the rest.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What do you say? Interested?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do?)

choices.text: 1. No, I don't intend to go with you.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Really? That's a shame...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If you change your mind, come find me deeper in the Mysterious Forest.

choices.text: 2. Go to the Mysterious Forest with Parmila.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes! I love that cool attitude!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes! I love that cool attitude! Then let's go right now. We'll warp there, so hold on tight!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This place... I came here with Platina before...)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Welcome to Mirgandia!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We're only at the entrance, and hardly anyone passes through, but this is... Oh, you've been here before? Impressive. This expedition is our first visit.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The Empire's mages temporarily connected the Imperial Gate to our camp.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That gate is the only way to come see us, so remember it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: By 'us,' I mean my mercenary company on the other side of the Imperial Gate.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We're about to take it across... but first...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anything you're curious about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I ask?)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's a request from the Empire. Our objective is to explore Mirgandia.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anything that looks promising for development, mysterious creatures, ruins... You could call it treasure hunting.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I don't understand nobles who pour huge sums into things like this. There are so many other useful ways to spend that much money.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Of course, for such a handsome payment for this kind of work, I'd even get down and lick their shoes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmila smiles sweetly, her expression at odds with what she just said.)

choices.text: 2. Tell me about the mercenary company.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: My people? They're all kind, strong, good people.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Well, there are one or two idiots...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: But they're fools, so you can just ignore them.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And... one of them is...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No, never mind. Let's talk after you meet them. Get along with everyone, all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For a moment, Parmila's expression seemed to darken... Was I imagining it?)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: All right. Shall we go?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Go through that Imperial Gate to reach our temporary camp. I'll see you there.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: This is our temporary camp. It may look disorganized, but finding somewhere this usable in such a devastated region took a lot of work!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The Imperial Gate is connected directly here, so feel free to visit anytime. Now, first...

lines.speaker: 건장한 체격의 남자
lines.text: Captain, a word...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, yes.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Sorry, %s. Have a look around and talk with everyone for now. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 건장한 체격의 남자
lines.text: ...Excuse us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The large man takes Parmila away. Shall I have a quick look around?)

steps.name: The Reason for the Invitation
steps.objective: Find out why Parmila summoned you to the Oscuras Temporary Camp. (Enter the Mysterious Forest in Midgard, then take the portal to the Mercenary Temporary Camp.)

lines.speaker: 파리한 안색의 청년
lines.text: Ugh... Ah... Uh... Aah... Uh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A young man with an unhealthy pallor. He seems to be saying something, but I can't understand it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I decide to ignore him and walk past.)
Are you %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I turn at the voice behind me and see a cheerful-looking young man.)

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Hello! My name is Barmun. The captain told me you'd be coming.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: This fellow with the dark circles under his eyes is Gron. Right now, I'm his mother... No, I mean his caregiver.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Gron's health has gotten a little worse since we came here.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: How much worse? He has a little trouble recognizing faces, has forgotten a little of how to speak, and finds it a little difficult to move around by himself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That doesn't sound like 'a little'!)

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Anyway, he wasn't ignoring you deliberately, %s. Please understand.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Gron, you've had too much sun. Let's go inside and lie down. We don't want those dark circles getting any worse.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Excuse us, then, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (With a friendly smile, the young man supports Gron and disappears inside.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...So you've met Gron.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmila has somehow come to stand behind me. Her expression is somber.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s... I meant to wait until you'd had more time to settle in here, but...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Gron is the reason I brought you here.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: He wasn't like that at first. He just spoke less and spent more time staring into space... I thought he was homesick. He was always quiet.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then he gradually forgot how to speak... At some point, his condition began deteriorating uncontrollably.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Now he can't do anything on his own.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Barmun is doing his best to care for him... but now his body is starting to waste away too.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Our company's doctor says the symptoms look like some kind of poisoning...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: But Gron hasn't done anything unusual, and we all prepare and eat the same food.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I sent other members to investigate the area Gron had been scouting, but they found nothing unusual.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's why I brought you here, %s.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Please find out what made Gron like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks as though I can complete the quest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I try an ordinary greeting.)

lines.speaker: 파리한 안색의 청년
lines.text: Uah... Uh... Uuuh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The greeting doesn't seem to have worked!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Just as I clench my fist, wondering whether to hit him...)
Huh? What are you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A cheerful-looking young man appears and steps between us.)
Oh, you must be %s. The captain told me about you.
But what's with that clenched fist? Surely you aren't cruel enough to hit a patient, %s?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Oh, I should introduce myself. My name is Barmun.

steps.name: Finding the Cause
steps.objective: Find out why Gron is acting strangely.

lines.text: 『Hidden Place』

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Beyond the hidden entrance lies a fairly spacious chamber.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Inside is a brilliantly glowing magic circle, with a strange object floating above it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'd better report this to Parmila.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Parmila about the hidden area in Quartz Cave.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...Quartz Cave? The others searched it several times... We couldn't find anything.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, no time to stand around. Let's go check it at once.
Wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A sharp-featured young man blocks the way.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...Callone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I've told you several times to call me 'Mr. Callone,' Parmila. Where are you going?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s found a strange place in Quartz Cave. We're just going to check it.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: As I've also told you repeatedly, I am obliged to report all of your activities.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: And of course, you're obliged to report anything unusual to me. Please refrain from acting independently without permission.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Quartz Cave, was it? I will accompany you.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...All right. %s can come too, can't they, Mr. Callone?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...I'm not enthusiastic, but since this person must guide us, I suppose there's no choice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmila frowns at Callone's words. She seems offended.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let's go, %s. Lead the way.

steps.name: An Unnatural Magic Circle
steps.objective: Talk to Parmila, then explore the depths of the Quartz Cave together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I return to the strange magic circle deep in the cave with Parmila and Callone.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...What is that?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I sense an unpleasant energy. Parmila, we should leave...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's beautiful...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ignoring Callone's warning, Parmila approaches the circle and the strange object as though entranced.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Parmila!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, look at this. That glow... It's incredible.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It must have some special power! Callone, we may have discovered something extraordinary!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmila circles the magic formation, chattering happily.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Callone says nothing. Somehow, he seems displeased.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s! Callone! Don't stand so far away. Come closer and look. This craftsmanship is amazing!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At Parmila's urging, I approach the magic circle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The wand floating in the center is certainly beautiful, as she said, but...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Somehow, it gives me chills.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (While I'm distracted by the wand, I realize Parmila's constant chatter has stopped.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Parmila?! Wake up!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ugh... Uuuh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think it might be a monster attack, but nothing is nearby.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Perhaps the magic circle is responsible. Just as I draw my weapon to destroy it, Callone speaks from behind me, supporting Parmila.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Stop that pointless behavior. That isn't something you can tamper with lightly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks as though I can complete the quest.)

steps.name: Investigating the Magic Circle
steps.objective: Destroy the magic circle to obtain the <Wand Fragment>, then turn in the quest to Callone in the "Quartz Cave Depths".

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...What are you? How is something like this possible...?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No, it's nothing. Let's get her out of here.

steps.name: Fragment of a Magic Circle
steps.objective: Talk to Parmila about the Wand Fragment, then find [Pikman].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I ask whether she's feeling all right.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. I ended up in your debt. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Actually, my memories are hazy. I was examining things in front of the circle... and then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmila thinks for a moment, then shakes her head with a frown.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...Anyway, I'm sorry. I caused you a lot of trouble, didn't I?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I suppose I should thank you too, Callone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...I told you to call me Mr. Callone.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Never mind that. %s, Callone says you broke the magic circle. Show me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explain that only a tiny fragment broke off, then hand it to Parmila.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hmm... How on earth did you break it?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Maybe it's because the fragment is small, but I don't feel the strange sensation I felt in the cave.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, whatever this is, it must have affected Gron...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, you're from the Empire. Have you ever seen anything like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I look at Callone, who seemed to know something back in the cave.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As soon as our eyes meet, he turns his gaze back to Parmila.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No. And please call me Mr. Callone.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, honestly! At least look at it properly... Ugh. Fine, fine. I'll ask my people.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, would you show this to the others?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who might know about something this strange...?)

steps.name: Fragment Analysis (1)
steps.objective: Collect 20 <Morning Dew Petals> from [Guardian Roses], [Guardian Dandelions], and [Guardian Hydrangeas] in the "Jade Forest".

steps.name: Fragment Analysis (2)
steps.objective: Collect 30 <Shadow Fragments> from [Possessed Souls], [Corrupted Grudges], and [Tainted Soul Fragments] in the "Quartz Cave".

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: What's this? A fragment of what? ...Is that a gem embedded in the corner?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: No, I've never seen it. Jubil's the one who likes gems. I'm not interested.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: The captain said I'd know if you asked me?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: ...Sometimes she overestimates me.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Hmm... I really don't know. Ask Pikman about something like this.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: He's full of all sorts of bizarre knowledge. He might know.

steps.name: Fragment Analysis (3)
steps.objective: Collect 20 <Dragon Wing Powder> from [Hierba Mariposas], [Viento Mariposas], and [Laguna Mariposas] in the "Jade Forest".

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: What is it, %s?

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: ...The captain told you to show this to me?

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Of course, nobody in this company knows more about gemstones than I do. Let me see.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: ...The craftsmanship feels similar to the Empire's.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: But this color, the angle of reflection... that swirling glow... I've never seen anything like it.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: As I look at it, I feel as though it's calling to me.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: It's beautiful... and somehow unsettling.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: ...Where on earth did you get this fragment?

steps.name: The Cure Is Ready?
steps.objective: Give the finished medicine to Gron.

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Hm? What is it?

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: What's that stone? How peculiar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explain what happened in the cave.)

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Woohoohoohoo!! A mystery! I smell a mystery!!!!

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: G-give it to me! I'll analyze it!

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Hehe, hehehe! Dissection! Let's dissect it!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks as though I can complete the quest.)

steps.name: Finding a Breakthrough
steps.objective: Return to the depths of the Quartz Cave.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So, Pikman. Why did you call everyone together?

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Hehe. Captain, my dear comrades... and, as an extra, %s too.

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: It's time for your hearts to tremble before the genius of the great Pikman! Hahaha!

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Ta-da!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pikman raises the medicine bottle in his hand for everyone to see.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A clear liquid sloshes inside.)

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: I have finally created a cure for Gron!!!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ?! How... in such a short time...?!

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: ...And what of it?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Don't you make one every day?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: The medicine that never makes him any better, you mean.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The company members' reactions are cold!)

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Grr, no!! No, I tell you!!! Don't doubt this genius! Anyone would struggle if they had to work without a clue!!

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: But if you were a real genius...

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Grr! Shut your mouth!!!

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Heh... Hahaha... This time is different, I tell you. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: You all saw the stone fragments the captain brought. Well, I analyzed them...

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Judging by the faint lettering on the fragment and the colors used, I thought it might be old imperial magic. So I dug through every ancient book I could find. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: But unexpectedly, it's similar to elven magic! Though I can smell human hands on it. Hahaha! ...Anyway, the main purpose of this magic is binding.

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Look here. Can you see the psychic force this fragment emits? No? It's faint, but it's there. That force keeps drawing everything around it inward. Forcibly!

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Human souls, for example. It pulls them in, eats away at their core, and when they're weak enough... BOOM! It shatters them! BOOM! Hehehe...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Pikman, you're rambling. What's the point?

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: ...At least let me explain... Sniff...

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Anyway, this medicine disperses that psychic energy!!!

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: If this thing is what got Gron, it should definitely work! Hahahaha! Now, young Barmun, give it to him!

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: ...Can we really trust this...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Looking doubtful, Barmun begins giving Gron the contents of the bottle.)

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: It's a creation of the genius Pikman! It'll work in no time. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Ugh... Uh... Uuuh...

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Ugh... Uuh... Aah... B...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (After twisting in discomfort for some time, Gron raises his head.)

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Bar...mun?

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Barmun... Why...? Huh... What are you all... doing here?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: !!! Gron!!! Do you recognize me? Gron!!!

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Y-yes, Barmun. I can hear you without the shouting.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Gron!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Overcome with emotion, Barmun embraces Gron. His eyes seem moist, but perhaps I should pretend not to notice.)

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Huh? What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: You... don't remember any of it?

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Hm? ...Remember... what... Ah!

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Gron? Gron?! Hey!!! What's wrong with you?! Open your eyes!!!! Gron!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (With a small cry, Gron loses consciousness. Barmun shakes his limp body frantically.)

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Oh dear... A side effect?

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Gron!!!

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Uh... Ah... Auh...

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Oh no... Gron has gone back to the way he was... And he's drooling... He seems even worse.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: He seemed lucid for a moment. Was it a failure?

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Urgh... The mixture was correct. Phew... It seems the psychic force has a stronger hold on him than I thought...

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Then there's no way to bring Gron back...?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Do we need another approach...?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s. I'm sorry to keep asking, but could you help us a little longer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As long as the magic circle remains, medicine may be useless for Gron. We'll need another solution.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I return to the depths of Quartz Cave, hoping to find another clue...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (And encounter a familiar face.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...You again.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: You really do get on my nerves at every turn.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I ask what he was doing.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: That's none of your business.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I ask why he was inspecting and touching every part of the magic circle.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...You have a nasty personality.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I wasn't doing anything much. I came to see whether I could find a way to restore Gron.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: What are you doing here? Did Parmila send you?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Whatever the case, don't approach that... that magic circle. Even if its energy doesn't affect you, staying here too long isn't good.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is Callone unaffected by the magic circle's power?)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Well, I'm familiar with it. With a little know-how, that artifact isn't particularly...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: That was a slip of the tongue. Pardon? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No? I don't really... I don't know what that is at all.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...I'm starting to resent Parmila for bringing you here.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: And I resent my own careless mouth...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Very well. I'll tell you what you want to know.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Let's go outside first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks as though I can complete the quest with Callone.)

steps.name: The Truth Behind the Incident
steps.objective: Listen to Callone's story with Parmila.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...I disliked you from the moment we met. I thought it was because something about you was different.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Perhaps that feeling was a premonition of this moment.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: You must already have your suspicions. I don't want you misunderstanding through speculation, so I'll explain myself.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I originally belonged to Laboratory No. 2 of a private magical research institute within the Empire. I served as its director, leading and supervising the researchers.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: We sought to study the domination and control of human emotions through fear.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Humans display superhuman strength when exposed to extreme terror. If we could remove only the emotion of fear from that state, perhaps they could control that strength rationally...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...That was the subject of our research.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: But our research reached a limit.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Human emotions have thresholds. At some point, people overcame their fear, which took us in a direction different from the result we wanted.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: That was when we obtained what you see before you: Degos's artifact.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I needn't explain how we acquired it. Do you know the being called Degos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How should I answer?)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Then this will be quicker.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: That is something like a magical circuit containing a concentration of Degos's demonic power.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: We intended to analyze it and create an object that could continuously inflict upon humans the terror produced by a being beyond humanity.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: But we failed.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The subjects merely lost their minds to overwhelming fear. They did not function through the mechanism we intended.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...You may already have guessed. That must be what caused Gron's condition.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: He must have found the entrance while exploring the cave, then been exposed to the artifact's power while investigating.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: This is the first time I've learned that prolonged exposure can cause such a condition, but...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I don't know why he didn't tell anyone before it became so severe.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...What is that expression? Do I seem cruel to you?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: But I am confused too.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The research failed, and the project ended. I was sent here in what was effectively a demotion.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: But how that artifact came to be here... I don't understand it either.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Degos. The fallen ruler. One of the lords of the demon realm, also called the Incarnation of Rage. Rumor says he was originally human, but there's no way to verify it.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: A being of tremendous demonic power, sealed somewhere in this land. They say that when his seal breaks, he will bring the end of this world.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Of course, I've never seen him with my own eyes...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: In any case, if my deductions are correct, that is an artifact containing Degos's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (After hearing the whole story, Parmila seems unexpectedly calm.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So, in other words, you were trying to create emotionless human weapons?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No! You've misunderstood. We only sought to study the hidden, transcendent power within humans. We never intended to misuse it!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Isn't that just your own opinion? Did everyone agree with you?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Of course... there were some who argued that all research must have practical applications...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Your master probably thought the same way.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, your research succeeded in the end. Without you, Callone...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: It seems so. Shortly after reporting our failure, I was hurriedly sent here. But seeing that, I can only conclude that they succeeded afterward.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: It's the form we predicted our successful research would take. How on earth... And why did I have to be excluded...? I truly don't understand. I'm confused.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...What I don't understand is why our Gron had to suffer because of your selfish experiments.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...I am sorry about that.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Forget it. Blaming you won't restore Gron.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...You're generous.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's because you seem to be a victim too, and I feel sorry for you.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Pardon? ...What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, you looked intelligent, but perhaps you aren't.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Do you still not understand? You were used and discarded.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: A capable subordinate who knows all of his master's plans and opposes them. You must have been a thorn in his side.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wouldn't you be the perfect first target for testing an immensely powerful weapon?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ?! Th-that's... Impossible.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I... was used...? That can't be... Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Callone seems deeply shocked.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Of course, it looks as though we were prepared as guinea pigs for that weapon too...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...I thought the pay was suspiciously good. Tsk...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I ask Parmila what she plans to do next.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I wonder. My head is spinning too.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Keep this secret from the other members for now. I don't want to make things more complicated. And...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I especially don't want to see Barmun charging in and demanding that we kill Callone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmila glances at Callone, her tone unmistakably cynical.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: !!! Ugh... I-I'm sorry. Even if I didn't do it myself... I deeply apologize for the harm caused to your company...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Just words?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I-I'll contact my homeland and have your payment increased!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's what I'm saying. You were a disposable pawn from the start. How would that be possible? Sigh...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, you're much more foolish than you look.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That isn't what I want from you. I don't want to get tangled in your people's filthy schemes either...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What I want is that artifact destroyed.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If we destroy the source of what changed Gron, Pikman's medicine should cure him and bring him back to us. Am I wrong?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I... believe that is correct.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, you know how to destroy it, don't you? You studied it. You must know.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I-I failed and was practically thrown out of the institute... And I didn't create that completed artifact...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...I don't know whether I can.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No. You'll have to. If you tell me you can't, I might kill you.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Make it happen.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...I will try.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: %s. Reluctant as I am, I think I'll need your help. Would you assist me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's complete the quest.)

steps.name: Preparations (1)
steps.objective: Collect 10 each of <Mariposa's Butterfly Crystals> from the "Jade Forest", and <Waitl's Gem Crystals> and <Golem's Gem Crystals> from the "Quartz Cave".

steps.name: Preparations (2)
steps.objective: Collect 40 <Black Extract> from [Possessed Souls], [Corrupted Grudges], and [Tainted Soul Fragments] in the "Quartz Cave".

steps.name: Destroy the Artifact (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Petit Degos] and bring back <Petit Degos's Horn>.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I will now use the materials %s brought to draw out Degos's power sealed within the artifact.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Parmila, wouldn't it be better for you to take shelter elsewhere?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I can look after myself. Don't worry about me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmila's eyes are filled with resolve. Callone sighs quietly, then continues.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Here's the plan. I'll use these gems, which hold Mirgandia's power, to alter the artifact's magical circuits. Their structure will invert, the power will flow in reverse, and Degos's sealed power will be drawn out.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Then the new magical circuits I've engraved will give that power physical form. After that, %s, you must destroy the manifestation of Degos's power.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'll take that role...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No, Parmila. Once manifested, the demonic power will be far stronger. It may not end with you merely losing consciousness this time.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: For reasons I don't understand, %s is completely unaffected by it. Leaving this to the adventurer is safer.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: If something happened to you too... I couldn't face the mercenaries.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Seemingly convinced by Callone's words, Parmila reluctantly nods and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Now, %s, do you understand your task?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How should I answer?)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Your role is the most important. If you make a mistake... all of us could be in danger.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Please don't betray my trust.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Then I will begin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Callone begins working on various parts of the artifact.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Since I can't understand what he's doing, I decide to wait quietly with Parmila.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How much time has passed...? Callone turns toward us.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: It's ready. Now, if I activate this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Callone presses the last gem fragment in his hand into a groove in the artifact.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Get ready, %s!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But nothing happens.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...?! That can't be...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Callone starts adjusting the artifact again, but soon his expression becomes resigned.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...It seems I've failed.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: This appears to be beyond what I can handle now. ...I'm truly sorry.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I don't want to hear such irresponsible words!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For now, let's complete the quest with Callone.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Have you forgotten already...? Are you really an idiot?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: When the manifested Degos appears, just defeat it! Even an idiot should understand that much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmila and Callone stare at me with wide, startled eyes.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: %s!! Where were you?!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Are you all right? You suddenly disappeared! You scared us!! I was worried!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explain that Petit Degos appeared near the artifact and that I defeated it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Apparently, neither of them could see Petit Degos.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: If %s's explanation is true, then we succeeded in manifesting Degos's power sealed within the artifact.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Why only you could see it... I can't explain. Did the demonic power distort space?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: In any case, if it manifested in such an incomplete form, I suspect the artifact itself was not fully perfected.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: And you defeated Degos too... That is excellent news.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then will Gron return to normal now?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The link between the lingering psychic force and the artifact should be severed. I believe Pikman's medicine will help now, though I don't know how long it will take...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: As long as he can definitely return to normal, I don't care how long it takes.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: All right, both of you. Let's return to camp. We'll seal this entrance now.

steps.name: Every Farewell Leads to a New Meeting
steps.objective: Return to Parmila at the "Oscuras Temporary Camp".

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: One job wrapped up, then! It was hectic, but somehow we managed to settle it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, thank you so much for helping. You came all this way because of me and went through so much. I'll never forget this favor. And...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...Thank you, Callone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: (He flinches.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You don't need to be so wary. I really... simply want to thank you.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: For giving Gron back to us.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Ahem... Ahem. Not at all. Rather, I'm the one who owes everyone in the Oscuras company an apology.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Even if I didn't do it directly, I helped bring it about. Of course I should take responsibility to the end.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I intend to return to my homeland and confront them in person.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What?! No!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Oh, don't worry. I'll make sure your payment is settled properly.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No! That isn't the problem!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If you go back there, you might be killed!!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Yes, perhaps. But if that is the result of the research I pursued, I believe it cannot be helped.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ugh... Ugh... Oh, honestly!!!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Why am I surrounded by so many clueless idiots?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If you say, 'I'll take responsibility with my life,' and die, is that the end of it? That's only running away to ease your own conscience!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If you truly think you've done wrong and want to take responsibility, you have to face reality and choose the most useful course!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...I thought this was the most reasonable approach available...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: May I make a proposal, Callone?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Join our mercenary company.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Pardon?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Don't report anything to the Empire. Join us instead.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And send false reports saying the exploration is proceeding smoothly. A spy, you might say?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Pardon?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then you don't have to die, we don't lose our jobs, and we keep earning money! ...And we won't let them push us around as they please.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's a win-win for everyone. ♪

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Parmila, are you serious?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Today's enemy is tomorrow's friend.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I think it's an extremely reasonable approach. What do you think?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (After considering for a moment, Callone takes the hand Parmila offers with a smile.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Then perhaps I'll join on a provisional basis.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh? Such an attitude from a new recruit! I'm already starting to regret inviting you!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Heh... Then I look forward to working with you, Captain.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You should add 'ma'am,' shouldn't you?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Ugh... Y-you hold grudges more than one would expect. Captain... ma'am.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ahahahaha! Shall we go say hello to everyone?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Barmun will be delighted that he can finally get to know you, Callone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Looking genuinely distressed, Callone begins trudging ahead.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As I look sympathetically at his slumped shoulders, Parmila speaks in a whisper.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let me thank you properly once more.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: As leader of the Oscuras Mercenaries, I sincerely thank you.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Um, if you'd like, would you join our company too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm grateful for the offer, but decide to decline.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: All right. Somehow, I thought you'd refuse... Still, it's a shame.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then I'll make you an honorary member. Come visit anytime, all right?

translation.method: Fresh translation from the current Korean source
